review_candidates.title: Business Process Engineering | Senior Manager
review_candidates.description: The Process Engineer - Business Process & AI Automation will understand how work is performed across the business, document current-state and future-state processes in Lucidchart, and recommend practical improvements and automation opportunities. The role will partner with process owners and frontline teams to identify inefficiencies and assess where AI agents, rule-based automation or process simplification can deliver measurable value. Working with IT and AI teams, the Process Engineer will translate approved opportunities into clear workflow designs and requirements, support pilots, and help embed improved ways of working. This is a business process improvement role, not a manufacturing engineering or AI research position. Responsibilities Discover and understand end-to-end business processes through stakeholder interviews, workshops, observation and document review; capture activities, owners, systems, inputs, outputs, business rules, handoffs and exceptions Create, validate and maintain clear current-state and future-state process maps in Lucidchart, using swimlanes and BPMN where appropriate; secure process-owner agreement and maintain consistent documentation and version control Analyze process performance to identify bottlenecks, repetitive work, rework and control gaps; simplify workflows and prioritize improvements using business value, feasibility, risk, effort and expected return on investment Recommend where AI agents and agentic workflows can automate or assist work, such as document processing, request triage and cross-system task coordination; distinguish these opportunities from those better suited to rules, RPA or human judgment Design future-state automation workflows and partner with IT and AI teams on pilots; define agent tasks, tools, data access, human approvals and exception handling, and validate results against agreed business outcomes Translate approved designs into business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and implementation handover packs, including system dependencies and process controls Establish baseline and post-change measures, including cycle time, manual effort, error rates, cost and service quality; estimate benefits and verify realized improvements Coordinate user acceptance testing, including normal, exception and AI-failure scenarios; define escalation and manual fallback paths with business and technical owners Work with Cyber Security, Risk and Compliance to address data privacy, least-privilege access, audit trails and human oversight before automation is introduced Support change management through updated procedures, training and stakeholder communication; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and review adoption and results Perform job duties safely, attend work as scheduled on a consistent and regular basis, and perform other related duties as assigned Requirements 5 years of experience in Industrial Engineering, Business Process Management, Information Systems, Business Analytics or a related field. Proficiency in Lucidchart for flowcharts, swimlane diagrams and collaborative process documentation; familiarity with BPMN and structured process repositories. Strong Excel and presentation skills; familiarity with reporting tools such as Power BI and workflow platforms such as Power Automate, UiPath or n8n is desirable. Understanding of APIs, system integrations and data flows; experience configuring an AI-agent or low-code workflow platform preferred. Basic SQL or Python is an advantage, not a core requirement Certifications in Lean Six Sigma, BPM / BPMN, business analysis training or automation workflows Proven experience in business process analysis, improvement or business analysis, with examples of stakeholder-validated process maps and measurable improvements. Experience in hospitality, integrated resorts or other service operations is an advantage. Strong process discovery, workshop facilitation and documentation skills; able to identify root causes, clarify ambiguous requirements and communicate with frontline teams, management and technical specialists Working knowledge of Lean, continuous improvement and process measurement; able to develop business cases, compare options and prioritize opportunities using evidence. Practical understanding of AI agents, tool use and multi-step workflows, including limitations such as unreliable outputs and inappropriate actions Able to define human oversight and testing needs. Hands-on automation or AI pilot experience preferred; advanced model development is not required.

For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates: Internal candidates External female candidates Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu Second tier candidates include: All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM. They oversees the preparation of IOM’s statutory financial statements ensuring IPSAS compliance, management reporting on the Organization’s financial performance and position, project financial report certification and global accounting operations. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Languages For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written). Working knowledge of French and/or Spanish is an advantage. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.
